headline: Western Oregon end Seattle Pacific's unbeaten run
dek: Western Oregon's win was Seattle Pacific's first defeat since the opening night of conference play, at Northwest Nazarene. It also drew the two level as the conference's highest scorers: Western Oregon's 37 goals in all matches are more than any programme bar Seattle Pacific has scored.
displaced_by: Western Oregon beat Seattle Pacific: the leaders are no longer unbeaten since conference play opened, and no longer alone on the most goals.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's 32 goals are more than Simon Fraser, Western Washington or Northwest Nazarene have scored, yet they sit bottom of the table: goals in this conference have not bought points.

wire.line: Saint Martin's have won seven matches, none of them in conference play.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches whose dates have passed carry no result, and every one of them is a Simon Fraser home match from August.
